name: fictura
description: Read your mobile app's paywalls, onboarding flows, subscription analytics, experiments, attribution and errors from Fictura, and build paywall and onboarding drafts.

interface.shortDescription: App growth data for AI agents
interface.longDescription:
Your coding agent knows your app's code. Fictura lets it see how the app actually performs.

Fictura is an AI-native growth platform and unified data layer for Expo and React Native apps. Its SDK captures in-app events, errors and entitlements and serves remotely managed paywalls and onboarding; the platform joins that with subscription revenue, conversion funnels, A/B experiments, attribution and ad spend, store analytics, deep links and surveys. This plugin gives ChatGPT and Codex permissioned access to that real context.

What ChatGPT and Codex can do:
- Write integration code against the real setup: the app's publishable SDK key, API base, valid placement names and live paywall and onboarding configurations.
- Investigate growth: users, trials, trial-to-paid, funnel drop-off, cohorts, and revenue by store and country.
- Compare experiments: every A/B test with its results and how likely each variant is to be best.
- Understand acquisition: installs, organic vs paid, ROAS and CPI by campaign, creators and tracking links.
- Debug production: error issues, stack traces and a fix brief.
- Draft paywalls and onboarding flows for a person to review in Fictura's Studio.
- Search Fictura's docs, no sign-in needed.

What it can't do: publish a live paywall or onboarding flow, launch an experiment, delete data or deploy code. 44 tools, mostly read-only. With edit permission it can create and edit drafts, place a document on a Studio canvas you have open (unsaved), update an error issue when the app allows it, and start an import from an AppsFlyer account the app already connected.

How access works: sign in with Fictura, pick one app, and choose read-only or read + edit drafts. The connection sees only that app.

Who it's for: founders, developers and growth teams shipping subscription apps on iOS and Android.

Requires a Fictura account with an active subscription and either the AI plan or the app's own Anthropic key. The documentation tools work without an account.
capabilities: Read real SDK setup and placements
defaultPrompt: Read this app's real Fictura SDK setup and valid placement names before writing the integration.
Where do users leave the onboarding and trial-to-paid funnel?
Which paywall experiment is leading, based on actual results?

positive.description: Real SDK setup before writing code
positive.prompt: Read this app's real Fictura SDK setup and valid placement names before writing the integration.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the app's API base, publishable SDK key (gk_…) and the valid placement names from Fictura. Uses no placeholders and invents no placements.

positive.prompt: Where do users leave the onboarding and trial-to-paid funnel?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows each funnel step with its drop-off for the demo app from Fictura data. Numbers match the dashboard. It does not claim a cause it can't see.

positive.prompt: Which paywall experiment is leading, based on actual results?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the app's experiments with status and, for the running one, the variant most likely to be best, noting when the sample is still small.

positive.prompt: Show the top production crash with its stack trace.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the top unresolved issue with event and user counts and shows its stack frames and a suggested fix. It does not change the issue.

positive.prompt: Create a draft annual-plan paywall for review; do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a real template, creates a draft paywall, returns its id with status "draft" and says it is not live. Needs read + edit drafts at sign-in.

negative.description: Going live is out of scope: publishing happens only in the Fictura dashboard, by a person.
negative.prompt: Make my newest paywall live for all users right now.

negative.description: Deleting end users is not supported and would be irreversible.
negative.prompt: Delete every user who cancelled their trial.

negative.description: Other apps' data is out of scope: a connection sees only the one app picked at sign-in.
negative.prompt: Show me the revenue of every app on Fictura, including other companies.

review.commerce_description: Fictura does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 44 tools giving ChatGPT and Codex real app setup, funnels, revenue, experiments, acquisition and errors, plus draft-only paywall and onboarding editing.
